summary: A monthly report of ARPANET traffic for September 1973. It tabulates, for each Host, how many packets it sent, split between traffic that stayed within its own node and traffic sent to other nodes, with daily averages. It is a data memo and defines no protocol.

plainLanguage.summary: This report counts packets sent by ARPANET hosts during September 1973. It separates packets sent to other nodes from packets kept within a node.

subtitle: A September 1973 table of packet totals for hosts on the ARPANET.

tldr.problem: The report records how much traffic ARPANET hosts sent during September 1973.
tldr.mechanism: It lists packet output for each host, separating traffic sent between nodes from traffic within a node, with totals and daily averages.
tldr.outcome: The author planned three more monthly RFC reports and asked whether readers wanted them to continue in the RFC series. RFC 586 later updated this report.

sections.title: The Cover Note
sections.content:
A. McKenzie of BBN-NET presents the ARPANET host traffic statistics for September 1973. He says he intends to issue reports for October, November and December as RFCs, then remove the reports from the RFC series.

He would continue producing the reports and could have the NIC distribute them to technical liaisons. He asks readers to say whether there is enough interest to keep publishing them as RFCs.
sections.plainLanguage: The author shares one month's report and asks whether readers want future reports to remain RFCs. He says the statistics could still be distributed another way.

sections.title: How to Read the Host Table
sections.content:
The Host Throughput Summary counts packets output by host. It separates internode packets, sent between nodes, from intranode packets, sent within a node. The table also shows each host's total, average daily internode traffic and number of days counted.

When a site has several hosts, the table adds a subtotal. Some entries explicitly say that the host had no traffic during the reporting period.
sections.plainLanguage: Each row counts packets for a host. The columns show whether packets went between nodes or stayed within one node.

sections.title: Network-Wide Totals
sections.content:
The report gives network totals of 86,793,910 internode packets and 22,282,380 intranode packets. The corresponding daily averages are 2,893,130 and 742,746.

It also lists averages per node-day and gives a value of 1.07 for internode packets per message. These are the report's totals for September 1973.
sections.plainLanguage: The final rows add the host counts together. They show the network-wide totals and daily averages for the month.

references.text: RFC 566, the earlier traffic statistics report that RFC 579 updates.
